Yahtzee Dice Game

Full Yahtzee rules — 5 dice, 3 rolls, all 13 scoring categories, upper-section bonus, and total score.

Press Roll Dice, tap dice to hold, then pick a category.

📖 How to use

  1. Press Roll Dice (3 rolls per turn).
  2. Tap dice to hold the ones you like.
  3. Pick an empty category to score the dice.
  4. Fill all 13 categories — highest total wins!

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which scoring categories are included?

Ones through Sixes, Three of a Kind, Four of a Kind, Full House, Small/Large Straight, Yahtzee, and Chance.

How do I hold dice?

Tap dice to hold them between rolls — held dice keep their value when you roll again.

How many rolls per turn?

You get 3 rolls per turn. After rolling, pick an empty category to score your dice into.

What is the upper section bonus?

Score 63+ in the upper section (Ones–Sixes) to earn a 35-point bonus.
